summary: A combat action as an asset: add an attack or skill by creating one, with no code change.
overview: An attack, heal or skill as a ScriptableObject rather than hardcoded logic. It builds on GameDataAsset for the id, which is the same pattern items and currencies use — so moving Combat into another project means taking that folder too.
useCases: A designer adding a skill without a programmer.
Sharing one action between several enemy types.
Balancing numbers by editing assets rather than recompiling.

gotchas.title: The target type decides who is offered, not what is legal
gotchas.body: It filters the candidate list. Anything more conditional than that belongs in the brain's scoring.
